description: This source file implements a GStreamer audio sink element for Rialto media streaming, handling media source creation, state changes, property management, and event handling specific to Rialto's MSE audio sink functionality.

classes.name: RialtoGStreamerMSEAudioSink
classes.description: A GStreamer element implementing a Rialto-specific audio sink for Media Source Extensions, managing media source attachment, property handling, and state transitions.

methods.name: rialto_mse_audio_sink_change_state
methods.description: Handles state changes for the audio sink, attaching media player client and configuring stream info when transitioning from READY to PAUSED.

methods.name: rialto_mse_audio_sink_create_media_source
methods.description: Creates a media source object based on the provided GstCaps, configuring audio parameters and mime type.

methods.name: rialto_mse_audio_sink_event
methods.description: Handles GstPad events, particularly CAPS events, to attach media sources based on caps.

methods.name: rialto_mse_audio_sink_get_property
methods.description: Retrieves properties such as volume and mute status from the media player client.

methods.name: rialto_mse_audio_sink_set_property
methods.description: Sets properties such as volume and mute status on the media player client.

methods.name: rialto_mse_audio_sink_qos_handle
methods.description: Handles QoS events, posting QoS messages to the GstBus.

methods.name: rialto_mse_audio_sink_init
methods.description: Initializes the audio sink, setting up sink pad functions and QoS callback.

methods.name: rialto_mse_audio_sink_class_init
methods.description: Class initialization for the RialtoGStreamerMSEAudioSink, setting up properties, state change function, and supported mime types.
